Rouge costume.
Obtained from the Costume Gacha.

lines.text:
There's a saying that luck is also a form of skill. 
Would you like to test your luck, Highroller?
Flipping coins is... a habit of mine.
What game would you like to play today?

The coin landed heads side up.
Maybe that's because you're here with me, Highroller.

Please, heads... heads... heads... Phew, it's heads.
Whoa, I got fixated on that real fast.
I'm not as scared of tails anymore. Thank you, Highroller.

It landed heads side up, so Highroller will come soon.
I just have to wait a little longer.

I get uneasy when I don't see you often. Maybe I've been jinxed.
But please, come back soon.

This place doesn't have much to offer in terms of entertainment.
Whenever you're bored, come visit Coin Rush.

This is a nice place.
Why don't we set up a game center here as well?
Would you like to play a game with me?

I'm Rouge, the Game Master.
Would you like to play a game with me?
I'm getting luckier. I can feel it.
Now we can play more exciting games.
No one in all of Coin Rush will be able to beat me today.
Thank you so much, Highroller.

I had a feeling that today would be a lucky day.
Thank you, Highroller.
As thanks, I'll come up with even more exciting games.
May fortune always favor you, Highroller.
I've noticed that whenever I meet you, I feel elated.

I have a game that can be played with the two of us.
Are you interested?
I'll be the best hand in your deck.
The game is ready.

I'll set off with my right foot first.
Just a small superstition, don't worry about it.
Time to flip the coin.
You're about to witness my ultimate performance.
Shall we start the game?
This match will be fun!
Please, bring me luck.
I'll reload.
Highroller, step back.
It's my turn.
Let's test your luck.
I'm all in!
Who's up next?
My lucky day.
Luck wasn't on your side.
Ugh...!
Argh!
Ouch...!

I'm sorry, Highroller...
I must be unlucky.
It looks like we won this game.

... I'm fine.
It's a lucky... outfit after all.

Even if I'm not quite like Blanc or Noir,
if I can bring even just a tiny bit of luck to others...

You can't focus on the game?
Wh-what do you mean...

If you're looking at me like that... it means you like it, right?
... Hehe, I'm glad I wore this lucky outfit. It's totally worth it.
I'll be your personal lucky bunny, Highroller.

Focus on the game for now, please.
If you want to look... you can stare all you want later.

... There's so much to fuss about with this outfit.
Y-you didn't see anything, did you...?

... I guess you're busy.
I'll just quietly stay by your side and recharge your luck.
Was it really a good idea to come out dressed like this for publicity...?

Oh, Highroller. 
I'm so glad you're here. I was really nervous being alone.

B-be sure to... join C-Coin Rush's latest event...
*Sigh* I should go get changed...

Hello, Highroller. Which game are you inter—
Don't mind my clothes. It's just my lucky outfit.
Hehe. Is it possible to get even luckier?
I'll use all this luck on you, Highroller.

Why don't we test how much stronger I've gotten?
How about a game?
Thank you, as always.
Thank you for the luck you've given me, Highroller.
I'll repay you with even greater luck.
Will you be my good luck charm?
Meeting you might just be my greatest stroke of luck, Highroller.

A relationship where we exchange luck.
... Yeah. I'm really glad we have that kind of bond.
Stay tuned. Your lucky bunny is about to shine, Highroller.
With an outfit like this, I should be careful...

... I-I'll go a little slower.
If I'm not careful... things might slip off...
It's a little embarrassing, but I'm sure with this outfit, luck will follow.
Your lucky bunny will fight alongside you.
I better be careful not to ruin this outfit.
C-could you please look away for a moment?
Eek! The stickers almost fell off...!
Highroller wasn't watching... was he?
I need to cover up a little...
I'm ready, Highroller.
Shall I put my luck to the test?
Should I recommend this outfit to the others, too?
Victory to the bunny.
I won't have any bad luck in this outfit.
Easy enough.
Ugh.
My outfit...!
Eek...
Not again... This jinx...

That was lucky. But...
It was more embarrassing than I thought...
